items.title: Cursor Says Stolen Fireworks AI Key Led to Trojanized Claude Code Extension Incident
items.description: The compromise of Anthropic's official Claude Code extension on Cursor's extension marketplace was the result of the theft of an access key that was exposed in the wake of a breach targeting Fireworks AI.
